title: Text Shadow Generator
description: Design CSS text-shadows with sliders — offsets, blur, color and opacity — with a live preview and copyable code.
howto: Type your sample text (or keep the default).
Drag the offset, blur and opacity sliders and pick a shadow color.

faqs.a: A standard text-shadow declaration, e.g. text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); — with your exact values.
The picked color is converted to rgba() with your opacity value, so the shadow blends realistically over backgrounds.

faqs.q: Can I preview on a dark background?
faqs.a: Yes — toggle the dark preview to check how the shadow reads on both light and dark surfaces.
